Races

Each race sets your starting point and the path of growth you'll follow. There's no wrong choice — each one has its own power curve.

Earthling

Less powerful than the other races, but they make up for it with great adaptability and ingenuity — training to reach surprising power levels.

Saiyan

Born warriors who get stronger with every battle. Their power grows exponentially with transformations into Super Saiyan.

Demon Frost

Extremely powerful beings with a high capacity for evolution. Known for their multiple transformations and unusual resilience.

Namekian

A peaceful, wise race with regenerative powers and advanced ki manipulation abilities. Creators of the original Dragon Balls.

Majin

Beings made of a highly regenerative magical substance. Their bodies are malleable and can absorb others to increase their own power.

Bio Android

Created from the cells of powerful warriors. They combine abilities from several races and evolve through absorption into perfect forms. Once this race transforms, it can't revert back to its previous form.

Items

Machines and equipment that support your growth. Click each item's name to see all the details.

Gravity Machine

▼

A craftable machine that can be placed in the world to manipulate the gravity field around it. The higher the gravity intensity, the greater the training benefit — meaning higher XP multipliers.

Mechanic

  • Craftable: can be built and placed in the world.
  • Gravity manipulation: modifies the gravity field in the surrounding area.
  • Training benefit: higher gravity levels produce higher XP multipliers.

Operation & Fuel

  • Activation: needs any Redstone signal to turn on and run.
  • Automation: can be auto-refueled with a Hopper on its top face.
  • Capacity: maximum of 15 fuel units.
  • Consumption: higher gravity levels burn fuel much faster.

Fuel Values

Charcoal1 fuel
Coal1 fuel
Coal Block9 fuel
Lava Bucket15 fuel

Dragon Radar

This item helps you find the Dragon Balls.

Dragon Ball

With 7 Dragon Balls, you'll be able to summon the legendary dragon Shenlong, who will grant you 1 wish.

Shenlong — Summoning & Wishes

Gather the 7 Dragon Balls (use the Dragon Radar to find them).

Place the 7 balls on the ground, within a 3x3 area, to summon Shenron.

After use, they go on cooldown for 24,000 ticks (20 minutes).

Mastery & Alignment

Character alignment systems and transformation mastery.

Character Alignment

Mechanic

  • Alignment defines whether you are Good, Evil, or Neutral.
  • Depending on your alignment, interactions with NPCs and Masters may vary.
Transformation Mastery

Mechanic

  • Transformations can be mastered by taking damage while transformed.

Mastery Bonus

  • Once a transformation is fully mastered, it becomes up to 2x stronger.

Ki Sense

Gigantification

Buffs: 1.5x Life & Strength.
Debuffs: 0.5x Dexterity.
Cost: 4 SP

Kaioken

Effect: boosts your power at the cost of straining your body.
Cost: 6 SP

Multipliers: +10% Scale · +40% Dexterity & Strength.

🧬 Fusion System Overview

▼
Potara Fusion

The sacred fusion of the Supreme Kais, achieved through the mystical Potara Earrings.

Requirements:

👥 2 Players are required.

💎 Each player must equip one Potara Earring from the same pair.

Mechanic & Effects:

📈 Power Multiplier: drastically multiplies the power levels of both fused individuals, creating an unstoppable warrior.

🧠 Single Control: mind and body sync uniquely — only one user gains full control over the fused body.

Multiplier Formula:

The fusion's multiplier is the sum of the members' power levels, times 1.
Example: 50 + 50 = 100 × 1 = 100

Metamoran Fusion (Fusion Dance)

A symmetrical art form that requires perfect synchronization and precise positioning.

Requirements:

👥 2 Players must perform the ritual dance in close proximity.

📏 Height Condition: the height difference between both users must be less than 0.2.

Mechanic & Effects:

⚖️ Proportional Power: the smaller the height difference, the stronger the resulting fusion will be! Complete synchronization yields maximum power.

⚠️ Failure to meet the height requirement may result in an unsuccessful fusion.

Multiplier Formula:

The fusion's multiplier is the sum of the members' power levels, times 1.05.
Example: 50 + 50 = 100 × 1.05 = 105

Attributes

How the XP system works, how points are spent, and what each attribute and stat does for your character.

Level Up & XP System

▼

The XP methodology works as follows: the more hits you give, the more XP you will earn (5 XP per hit).

Every time you level up, you gain the following points to power up your character:

+5 AP (Attribute Points) per level

+1 SP (Skill Point) per level

Point Allocation Costs

▼

How to spend your points and how the scaling system works.

AP (Attribute Points)
Level 1 - 100Costs 1 AP per stat
Level 101 - 200Costs 2 AP per stat
Level 201 - 300Costs 3 AP per stat

The cost increases by +1 AP for every 100 attributes reached.

SP (Skill Points)

Used to unlock new skills.

Used to level up your existing skills.

Attributes Overview

▼

Spend your AP (Attribute Points) to increase your stats. Each attribute upgrades specific capabilities:

Constitution

Increases your life and stamina by 20 for each 1 point.

Dexterity

Partnership / Sponsorship

How giveaway partnerships with the Dragon Evolution server work. Click the card's title to see all the details.

Dragon Evolution Sponsorship Guidelines

▼
  1. You can set any simple requirement for entering the giveaway, such as joining your Discord server or following an Instagram page, for example. Generally, the more complex the task, the fewer people will participate, and the bigger the prize, the more people will participate.
  2. You can choose the duration of the giveaway between 1 and 7 days.
  3. The amount for purchasing the raffle prize must be provided to the team along with the payment for the promotional mention, so that it can be given to the winner(s) at the end of the raffle. If the winner(s) do not meet the prerequisites, other members may be selected in the raffle.
  4. We do not guarantee how many people will join the server for the giveaway; we only guarantee how many people will be notified. You can check past results on our giveaway channel.
  5. Our team will draft the giveaway message, but you can ask us to include any text you'd like (such as a slogan or a call to action); our team will review the text, and if we approve it, we'll include it.
  6. Dragon Evolution may add additional requirements to the giveaway, as well as additional entries for specific roles.
  7. Any servers or projects promoted that violate Discord's terms and guidelines will have their giveaways canceled without a refund.

Story Mode

Follow the journey through the Dragon Ball sagas, facing the iconic enemies of each arc.

Saiyan Saga

▼

The Warrior Named Raditz

Raditz, a strange warrior from space, arrived claiming to be Goku's brother. He didn't come in peace. Face him to defend Earth!
Objective: defeat Raditz — 120 HP ~ 1.8k BP

A New Threat Approaches

After Raditz's fall, Goku learns that two even more powerful warriors are on their way to Earth. They'll arrive in a year. Use this time to prepare!
Objective: defeat 4 shadows using King Kai's weight

Green Invaders: The Saibamen

Nappa and Vegeta have finally arrived! Nappa releases strange creatures called Saibamen to test Earth's warriors. Wipe them all out!
Objective: defeat 6 Saibamen — 80 HP ~ 710 BP

Nappa's Rampage

With the Saibamen defeated, Nappa goes on the attack and starts devastating everything in his path. Defeat him before it's too late!
Objective: defeat Nappa — 260 HP ~ 8.3k BP

Vegeta's Pride

Now it's Vegeta's turn! The Prince of the Saiyans has revealed his true strength. This will be the toughest battle of your life!
Objective: defeat Vegeta — 340 HP ~ 18.6k BP

Frieza Saga

▼

Invaders on Namek

After the brutal battle against the Saiyans, Earth was left devastated. Many friends fell, including Kami Sama and Piccolo. With their deaths, the Dragon Balls disappeared. Still, Kuririn has an idea: seek out the legendary Dragon Balls on Piccolo's home planet, Namek. Is there still hope?
Objective: defeat 6 Frieza Soldiers — 120 HP ~ 1.4k BP

Showdown with Cui

Cui was sent to eliminate any resistance on Namek. He underestimates you — prove him wrong!
Objective: defeat Cui — 380 HP ~ 15.9k BP

Brutal Dodoria

Dodoria is eliminating anyone who crosses his path. Face him before he gets more Dragon Balls!
Objective: defeat Dodoria — 340 HP ~ 10.8k BP

Zarbon Reveals His True Form

Zarbon looks refined, but he hides a monstrous form. Get ready for an intense battle!
Objective: defeat Zarbon — 380 HP ~ 18.1k BP

The Ginyu Force Arrives

Frieza has summoned his elite squad! Defeat Guldo and Recoome to keep moving forward.
Objectives: defeat Guldo — 120 HP ~ 1.6k BP · defeat Recoome — 320 HP ~ 9.6k BP

Burter and Jeice Attack

The Ginyu Force's speedy duo has arrived. Show them you're faster and stronger than they are!
Objectives: defeat Burter — 420 HP ~ 22.6k BP · defeat Jeice — 440 HP ~ 21.5k BP

Captain Ginyu and the Body Swap

Captain Ginyu uses a dangerous technique to swap bodies with his opponents. Defeat him before he uses it against you!
Objective: defeat Ginyu — 480 HP ~ 30.3k BP

Frieza's Fury

With his squad defeated, Frieza has decided to fight in person. Get ready to face his true power!
Objective: defeat Frieza — 540 HP ~ 50.1k BP

Final Form: Frieza

Frieza has reached his final form! This is the toughest battle of your life, don't lose control now!
Objective: defeat Frieza — 540 HP ~ 174.3k BP

The Emperor's Soldiers

Frieza and his father, King Cold, have arrived on Earth with a new army. Before the direct confrontation, defeat the soldiers threatening the citizens!
Objective: defeat 6 Frieza Soldiers — 120 HP ~ 1.4k BP

The Return of Frieza and King Cold

Frieza and his father, King Cold, have arrived on Earth with a new army. Before the direct confrontation, defeat the soldiers threatening the citizens!
Objective: defeat King Cold — 660 HP ~ 49.6k BP

End of the Threat

The time has come to finish off Frieza once and for all. This is your chance to protect Earth, fight with everything you've got!
Objective: defeat Cyber Frieza — 660 HP ~ 56.9k BP

Android Saga

▼

A Terrifying Future

Trunks arrived from the future carrying a grim warning: in a few years, killer androids will appear and destroy everything. Get ready!
Objective: defeat 2 training shadows in the Time Chamber using Super Saiyan

Showdown with Androids No. 19 and 20

Androids No. 19 and 20 have appeared and are causing destruction in the city. Stop them before it's too late!
Objectives: defeat Android No. 20 — 660 HP ~ 63.5k BP · defeat Android No. 19 — 700 HP ~ 62.6k BP

Duel with Android No. 17

After the first androids' defeat, Dr. Gero released two new ones: No. 17 and No. 18. No. 17 is eliminating anyone who crosses his path. Face him with everything you've got!
Objective: defeat Android No. 17 — 680 HP ~ 82.6k BP

Facing Android No. 18

Android No. 18 showed her strength by facing the Z Fighters. She's cold, calculating, and extremely powerful. Get ready for the battle!
Objective: defeat Android No. 18 — 660 HP ~ 81.0k BP

Perfect Monster

A new enemy has appeared: Cell, a bio-android created to absorb the Androids. He's on the loose — stop him before he reaches his perfect form!
Objective: defeat Cell — 975 HP ~ 209.7k BP

Buu Saga

▼

Pui-Pui, the Zoom Warrior

The sorcerer Babidi has begun his plan to free Majin Buu, gathering energy through battles inside his ship. His first defender is Pui Pui, a warrior from planet Zoon. Overcome this challenge to keep moving forward!
Objective: defeat Pui-Pui — 880 HP ~ 95.4k BP

Yakon, the Light Devourer

Yakon feeds on his opponents' luminous energy. Fight wisely and stop him from consuming your power!
Objective: defeat Yakon — 1060 HP ~ 158.0k BP

Dabura, King of Demons

Dabura, Babidi's most powerful commander, awaits you. He's cruel and relentless — defeat him to foil the sorcerer's plans!
Objective: defeat Dabura — 1040 HP ~ 179.7k BP

Majin Vegeta

Dominated by Babidi, Vegeta unleashed all of his pride and power. This confrontation will be more than a fight — it'll be a reckoning.
Objective: defeat Majin Vegeta — 360 HP ~ 111.6k BP

The Awakening of Majin Buu

Babidi succeeded! Majin Buu has been freed. Despite his childlike appearance, he's a devastating threat that must be contained immediately.
Objective: defeat Majin Buu — 1850 HP ~ 180.0k BP

Super Buu, Rising Fury

After absorbing powerful warriors, Majin Buu evolved into an even more destructive form. This battle will be the toughest yet.
Objective: defeat Super Buu — 1450 HP ~ 188.2k BP

Kid Buu, Pure Evil

Kid Buu is the original, most dangerous form of Majin Buu — chaotic, merciless, and unpredictable. The final battle for the universe's fate begins now!
Objective: defeat Kid Buu — 2225 HP ~ 599.3k BP

Beerus Saga

▼

The Awakening of Beerus

After a long sleep, the God of Destruction Beerus woke up with a hunch: a being of incredible power may soon emerge. He arrived on Earth in search of that warrior.
Objectives: defeat Beerus — 2220 HP ~ 873.4k BP · have Divine Ki

Golden Frieza Saga

▼

The Return of an Old Enemy

Frieza was resurrected by his followers and is training for revenge. Get ready for the chaos ahead!
Objective: defeat 6 shadows

Frieza's Army Attacks

With a new army, Frieza begins his offensive. Face the soldiers while he prepares for the final attack!
Objective: defeat 3 Frieza Soldiers — 340 HP ~ 11.4k BP

Tagoma and Shisami

Two warriors loyal to Frieza are destroying cities in his name. Face them and prevent further losses!
Objectives: defeat Tagoma — 1620 HP ~ 322.6k BP · defeat Shisami — 1780 HP ~ 299.9k BP

Golden Frieza

Frieza has mastered a new form: the Golden Form. His power is colossal. This will be a fight like no other!
Objective: defeat Golden Frieza — 2280 HP ~ 651.4k BP

Universe 6 Saga

▼

The Tournament of Universes

The God of Destruction Champa has issued a challenge: a tournament between the best warriors of Universes 6 and 7! You've been chosen to represent your universe. Before the battle begins, train with the Z Fighters and prove you're up to this legendary clash!
Objective: defeat Piccolo — 1530 HP ~ 319.1k BP

Botamo, the Rubber Bear

Your first opponent is Botamo. He can absorb physical attacks as if he feels no pain. Use strategy to beat him!
Objective: defeat Botamo — 2440 HP ~ 521.9k BP

Frost, the "Hero" of Universe 6

Frost seems noble, but he hides dark intentions. Fight carefully so you don't fall into his traps!
Objective: defeat Frost — 2580 HP ~ 702.0k BP

Magetta, the Lava Warrior

The heat from Magetta's metal body can destabilize anyone. Use your endurance to overcome him!
Objective: defeat Magetta — 2720 HP ~ 647.8k BP

Cabba, the Young Saiyan

Cabba is a Universe 6 Saiyan with a pure heart and great power. Show him the true pride of the Saiyans!
Objective: defeat Cabba — 1540 HP ~ 246.8k BP

Hit, the Legendary Assassin

Hit masters time-skip techniques that challenge even the gods. Overcome the limits of time to beat him!
Objective: defeat Hit — 3260 HP ~ 1.2m BP

How to Level Up

Two daily routines account for most of your XP and Attribute Point (AP) gains. Combine both to grow consistently.

Combat

Shadow Dummy

  • The Shadow Dummy copies your attributes and all your passive multipliers, so the challenge scales right along with you.
  • The more hits you land on the dummy, the more XP you earn in the session.
  • Since it mirrors your own stats, this training never gets "too easy" — it grows at your pace.
Minigame

Concentration Minigame

  • You have 3 attempts per day to play.
  • For every 5 points you score in a round, you earn 1 AP (Attribute Point) to invest in your character.
  • A great way to guarantee a daily source of attribute points, on top of combat XP.
Combat

Story Mode

  • You can now evolve by going through every episode of the anime, making you feel more immersed in the game.
